questions.question: Explain how women empowerment promotes gender equality.
questions.solution_html:
• Women empowerment promotes gender equality by giving women equal
  • access to education, resources, and decision-making, thereby reducing
  • discrimination and ensuring equal opportunities in society.
questions.final_answer: discrimination and ensuring equal opportunities in society
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Define the State Commission for Women.
questions.solution_html:
• The State Commission for Women is a statutory body established by state
  • governments to protect women’s rights, address grievances, and promote
  • gender equality at the state level.
questions.final_answer: gender equality at the state level
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: What is meant by Self Help Group (SHG)?
questions.solution_html:
• A Self Help Group (SHG) is a small voluntary group of people, usually
  • women, who come together to save money, support each other, and
  • improve their economic and social conditions.
questions.final_answer: improve their economic and social conditions
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: What is gender bias in scientific research?
questions.solution_html:
• Gender bias in scientific research is the unfair preference or unequal
  • representation of one gender over another in study design, data collection
  • analysis, or interpretation, leading to skewed or incomplete results.
questions.final_answer: analysis, or interpretation, leading to skewed or incomplete results
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

  • contributing to equality and overall community progress.( any two point, (1 mark)

questions.final_answer: Short Essay Questions

questions.question: Examine how reform movements worked for the upliftment of women.
questions.solution_html:
• Examine how reform movements worked for the upliftment of women.
  • By promoting education, abolishing social evils like child marriage and sati, and
  • advocating equal rights and opportunities for women.(each point (1 mark))
questions.final_answer: advocating equal rights and opportunities for women.(each point )
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: How can employment improve the life of widowed women?
questions.solution_html:
• By providing financial independence, enhancing self-confidence, and enabling
  • them to support themselves and their families.
questions.final_answer: By providing financial independence, enhancing self-confidence, and enabling
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Discuss the role of education in the National Policy for Women Empowerment.
questions.solution_html:
• Education in the National Policy for Women Empowerment plays a key role in
  • promoting equality, enhancing skills, and empowering women to participate fully
  • in social, economic, and political life.(any four point. (1 mark) each)
questions.final_answer: in social, economic, and political life.(any four point. each)
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Explain the important provisions of the Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013.
questions.solution_html:
• Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013.
  • Act ensures protection against workplace harassment by mandating Internal
  • Complaints Committees, defining harassment, providing complaint and redressal
  • mechanisms, ensuring confidentiality, and prescribing penalties for offenders.
questions.final_answer: mechanisms, ensuring confidentiality, and prescribing penalties for offenders
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Discuss the role of media in shaping women’s political participation.
questions.solution_html:
• Media plays a crucial role in shaping women’s political participation by creating
  • awareness, influencing public opinion, highlighting women leaders, and
  • encouraging greater involvement of women in political processes.
questions.final_answer: encouraging greater involvement of women in political processes
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Describe major issues in gender mainstreaming.
questions.solution_html:
• Major issues in gender mainstreaming include gender bias and stereotypes, lack
  • of awareness and participation, unequal access to resources and opportunities
  • weak policy implementation, and cultural and social barriers.( .(any four point. 1
  • mark each)
questions.final_answer: mark each)
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Explain the challenges globalization poses for women.
questions.solution_html:
• Globalization can create challenges for women by increasing job insecurity
  • widening wage gaps, exposing them to exploitative working conditions, and
  • limiting equal access to opportunities despite economic growth. (any four point. 1
  • mark each)
  • Essay Questions
questions.final_answer: Essay Questions
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Discuss the role of family, society, and government in supporting women in distress.
questions.solution_html:
• distress.
  • Family provides emotional support and protection, society promotes acceptance
  • and reduces stigma, and the government ensures legal aid, welfare schemes
  • and rehabilitation services to support women in distress.( any five point with a
  • short description each carries (2 marks))
questions.final_answer: short description each carries )

questions.question: Discuss different health policies in India for women.
questions.solution_html:
• India has several health policies for women such as the National Health Policy
  • National Rural Health Mission, and Janani Suraksha Yojana, which focus on
  • improving maternal health, reproductive care, and overall well-being of women.
questions.final_answer: improving maternal health, reproductive care, and overall well-being of women
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026
